gloss: to be put off; to be turned off; to recoil

definitions.gloss: to be put off; to be turned off; to recoil
definitions.explanation: To feel strongly repelled or uncomfortable because of someone's words or actions.

examples.japanese: その{発言|はつげん}にドン{引|び}きだ。
examples.english: That comment really turned me off.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{行動|こうどう}にみんながドン{引|び}きしていた。
examples.english: Everyone was put off by his behavior.

notes:
ドン{引|び}き combines ドン (emphatic prefix from onomatopoeia) + {引|ひ}く (to draw back). It expresses a strong negative reaction of being repelled or disgusted.

REGISTER:
This is casual slang popular among younger speakers. In formal contexts, use {引|ひ}く or {嫌悪感|けんおかん}を{抱|いだ}く.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ドン{引|び}きする: to be put off
- ドン{引|び}きだ: that's a turn-off
- ドン{引|び}きされる: to put someone off
